tags.name: Breakout
tags.description: Price moves above resistance or below support with momentum

tags.name: Reversal
tags.description: Trade entered expecting a change in trend direction

tags.name: Pullback
tags.description: Entered after a temporary retracement in an ongoing trend

tags.name: Trend Continuation
tags.description: Entered in the direction of the prevailing trend

tags.name: Fade
tags.description: Counter-trend trade expecting price to snap back

tags.name: Support Bounce
tags.description: Trade entered near a known support zone

tags.name: Resistance Rejection
tags.description: Trade taken after price fails to break resistance

tags.name: EMA Touch
tags.description: Trade initiated when price touches an important moving average

tags.name: Volume Spike
tags.description: Triggered by unusual volume activity indicating momentum

tags.name: Divergence
tags.description: Based on RSI/MACD showing divergence from price movement

tags.name: Inside Bar
tags.description: Trade setup formed after a narrow range day or bar

tags.name: Gap Fill
tags.description: Trade entered expecting price to fill a previous gap

tags.name: Pattern Break
tags.description: Triggered by breakout from a known chart pattern (flag, triangle, etc.)

tags.name: High Conviction
tags.description: Subjective tag denoting extra confidence in the setup

tags.name: Low Risk Entry
tags.description: Trade characterized by small stop size relative to potential reward

exitTactics.name: Target Hit
exitTactics.description: Exited when profit target was reached

exitTactics.name: Stop Loss Hit
exitTactics.description: Exited due to stop loss being hit

exitTactics.name: Manual Exit
exitTactics.description: Exited manually due to changing market conditions
